title: Smoky Kare Filipino-inspired Ramen
description: A twist on traditional Japanese ramen with smoky Filipino flavors.

ingredients.name: smoky soy sauce
ingredients.notes: smoked soy sauce for added depth

instructions: 1. Cook the noodles according to the package instructions.
2. In a separate pot, combine 1L of water, kare, sugar, and smoky soy sauce. Bring to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes.
3. Add the bonito flakes to the simmering pot and continue for another 2 minutes.
4. Add the kale to the pot and cook until wilted.
5. Divide the cooked noodles among bowls and serve with the smoky kare broth.
6. Garnish with lively rice vinegar and serve immediately.
